info.title: SendyKit API
info.description:
Canonical API contract for SendyKit v2.

Status tags on operations:
- x-status: live
- x-status: partial
- x-status: planned

Payment model:
- Stripe machine payments are the current machine-paid action mechanism.

Agent contract reconciliation:
- Tier and deployment availability are governed by Spec 50.
- Agent system/harness/send governance is governed by Specs 59-65.
- SaaS-only harness control-plane and branded-send provisioning surfaces are not customer-available in self-hosted builds unless Spec 50 is explicitly expanded.
- Internal control-plane contracts may be specified in docs before public OpenAPI exposure; they do not count as public parity claims until routed and documented here.
info.summary: Sendy-compatible email operations API with SendyKit exoskeleton, SaaS controls, readiness evaluation, and machine-paid premium actions.

get.description: Returns all skill definitions available to agents in the current tenant. Skills are reusable strategy templates that combine tool hints, prompts, and execution patterns. See Spec 65 for the skills contract.
Returns a single skill definition by ID, including its SKILL.md content, tool hints, and version metadata.

post.description: Attaches a skill bundle to an agent. The skill's tool hints become available to the agent during runs, narrowing (never widening) the agent's existing tool grants. See Spec 59 §6.5.
Detaches a skill bundle from an agent. The agent loses access to the skill's tool hints and execution patterns.
Validates a skill definition without attaching it. Checks SKILL.md syntax, tool hint references, and version compatibility.

200.description: Canonical agent runs for the current tenant

get.description: Returns canonical agent runs for the current tenant. Each run represents one orchestrated attempt to accomplish a goal — from planning through execution to completion or failure. See Spec 59 §6.2.
Returns a single agent run with full metadata: goal, entrypoint, status, cost tracking, approval state, and checkpoint references.

get.summary: List canonical actions for a run
get.description: Returns the ordered list of actions (steps) within a run. Each action has a type, tool reference, status, input/output payloads, and timing data.

get.summary: List canonical approvals for a run
get.description: Returns approval requests for a run. When an agent's action requires human approval (per the agent's approval policy), it creates an approval request that must be resolved before the run continues.
Returns artifacts produced by a run. Artifacts are versioned output objects (reports, drafts, summaries) with type, payload, and checksum.

get.summary: Get latest artifact by type for a run
get.description: Returns the latest artifact of a given type for a run. Useful for getting the most recent draft or summary without listing all artifacts.

get.summary: Get latest checkpoint for a run
get.description: Returns the latest checkpoint for a run. Checkpoints capture the run's resumable state — step position, serialized context, and resume token.

get.summary: Resolve a resume token to a checkpoint
get.description: Resolves a resume token to its checkpoint. Used to restore a run's state from a previously issued resume token.

post.description: Resolves a pending approval request by approving, rejecting, or cancelling it. The resolved_by field records who made the decision. Rejected approvals halt the run.
Create a new SaaS branded-send provisioning setup for an agent lane.

get.description: Fetch setup state plus slot, DNS, verification, task, and smoke details.

post.description: Pauses a branded agent-send setup. The agent retains its sender domain but cannot send until resumed. Provide an optional reason for audit.
Resumes a paused branded agent-send setup, restoring the agent's ability to send through its verified sender domain.
Permanently revokes a branded agent-send setup. The sender domain and associated DNS records are decommissioned. This action cannot be undone.

get.description: Returns the canonical tool catalog — all versioned tool definitions available in the system. Each tool declares its risk class, network class, scope type, execution mode, and idempotency contract. See Spec 61.
Returns a single tool definition with full schema (input_schema, output_schema) and policy metadata (risk class, exposure class, provider channels).

get.summary: List grants for an agent subject

200.description: Canonical grants for the requested subject

get.description: Returns standing permission grants for an agent. Grants define which tools an agent may use, in what scope, at what mode (forbidden/simulate_only/execute), and whether approval is required. See Spec 59 §6.4.
Returns schedules for an agent. Each schedule defines when the agent wakes up — cron, event trigger, or threshold — with overlap, retry, and misfire policies. See Spec 62.

post.description: Creates a new schedule for an agent. Requires a run template, trigger type, timezone, and policy configuration. The schedule starts in active status.

get.description: Returns a single schedule with full configuration: trigger type, cron expression, overlap policy, retry policy, misfire policy, and run template reference.

patch.description: Partially updates a schedule's configuration. Can modify cron expression, policies, timezone, or max active runs without recreating the schedule.

post.description: Pauses an active schedule. No new trigger deliveries are created while paused. Existing in-flight runs continue to completion.
Resumes a paused schedule. Trigger deliveries resume according to the schedule's cron or event configuration. Misfired triggers are handled per the misfire policy.

get.summary: List trigger deliveries for a schedule

200.description: Trigger deliveries for the requested schedule

get.description: Returns trigger deliveries for a schedule — concrete wake occurrences showing when the schedule fired, whether it created a run, retry count, and any errors.

post.description: Execute a previously planned action. Requires action to be in planned state.
